source_claim: Toei Animation's official Delicious Party Precure series information and character pages identify Cure Finale/Kasai Amane, Cure Yum-Yum/Hanam Ran, Fuwa Kokone/Cure Spicy, Narcistoru, Pam-Pam, and Shinada Takumi as named characters in the series. The pages describe their roles, profiles, transformations or official cast credits within this series.
notes: Checked Toei's series-info, transformation-character profiles, energy-fairy profile, enemy profile, and Takumi profile. The official Recipippi page describes a broad fairy category with many individual food-specific Recipippi, so the generic recipipi campaign member is deliberately left out of this positive batch.
